description: Trigger panel lists the fields the selected event's payload already carries (excluding envelope and actor fields).
Trigger panel offers a one-click lookup step (e.g. Add 'Find Ticket') for payload ids that have a lookup action, with the id input pre-wired.
Event-specific trigger tips (e.g. where a customer reply's text lives) resolve to the real path once the lookup step exists.
Event picker searches across all categories by name, code and synonyms; event category is searchable; synonyms expand only from name and code.

Palette search ranks exact, prefix, phrase and word label matches before synonyms, descriptions and nested field names, drops weak matches, and ranks business actions above generic transforms within a tier.
While searching, the palette lists individual actions inside groups as a full-name list; an empty search shows a No matches state with tips.
Curated MSP synonym groups (e.g. note→comment, reply→customer replied, counter→increment) power palette and event search.
The generic transform.assign node is labelled Set variables everywhere.
New steps insert after the selected step, or at the end of the selected container's first or chosen branch; the palette header states where the next step lands, with Reset.
Always-visible + insertion points and clickable empty branches (Add a step to this branch) with a New steps go here marker.
If and Try/Catch start with empty branches (no auto-added Return steps).
Default step output names are unique across the workflow (numeric suffix on collision).

One reachability computation (buildDataContext) decides which data a step can read: sibling If branches and loop-body outputs after the loop are excluded; both branches' outputs are readable after the If.
If steps offer a condition builder (match all/any; field / operator / value) that round-trips through the stored expression and falls back to Expression mode for unsupported shapes.
Condition values use the entity picker for the field's kind and selects for enums and booleans; Add condition opens the field picker with nothing preselected.
If cards show a plain-English summary with ids resolved to record names, a loading placeholder instead of raw ids, and a tooltip with the full source path.
tickets.find returns client, board, contact, status, priority, category, subcategory and assignee names plus client_id (company_id kept as alias).
tickets.find always returns latest_comment and latest_customer_comment using the shared customer-comment rule.
Output schema fields carry friendly descriptions; unlabelled fields are humanized (snake/camel case, acronyms) and shown as Label (path), with duplicates qualified by path.
Schema metadata marks entity ids on action outputs and on event and date-trigger payloads through one picker-kind registry (adds role, contract and asset kinds).
Each input has a single Value from control that selects the source and mode: a field, a specific record, text, a fixed value, or an expression; it shows the current source compactly.
One searchable, grouped field picker (trigger, steps, loop item, caught error, workflow run; meta last) serves Value from, Insert field (text and expression editors) and condition fields.
Free-text inputs (single- or multi-line, including email bodies, AI prompts and notes) get Text mode with {{field}} placeholders, field chips, Expand dialog and sample-data preview.
Text mode scope matches Expression and Reference modes: loop item and index, caught error and all runtime roots are insertable and resolve.
Switching between Text, Expression and Reference converts the value instead of wiping it; expressions that are not plain text-plus-fields stay in Expression mode with a note.
Insert field inserts at a deliberately placed caret and otherwise appends at the end.
A single-value reference into a list input is wrapped as a one-item list and reopens in Reference mode with an explanatory note.
Reference picking offers first and last items of record lists and an Entire result entry for a step's whole output.
Expression editors auto-grow, open in an Expand dialog, and preview results against sample data (first loop item inside For Each).
Syntax help lists every catalog function, list literals and pointers to Transform steps, laid out for the narrow panel.
Expression type inference parses the JSONata tree so concatenation reads as text and comparisons as true/false; MAPPING_TYPE_UNKNOWN is phrased in plain language.
Default fill mode is chosen per field: pickers for entity ids, text entry for strings, Reference only for a same-name type-matched source.
Suggestions are type-, entity-kind- and role-aware (actor/by fields never fill other roles; meta.* and error.* never suggested); free-text inputs get no automatic suggestions.
Apply suggestions bulk-fills only required, empty inputs with same-name type-matched sources and lists every pair in its tooltip; side-effectful optional inputs are never bulk-filled.
Structured object editors set only the sub-fields the author adds; booleans the author sets start true; numbers start inside their allowed range; required choices start at their first option.
Card badges, graph badges and the panel's N required missing count come from one mapping-state source, treating empty lists and blank objects as unset.
Comment visibility on Add Comment, Create Ticket initial comment and Add Attachment is an explicit Internal/Public choice in the designer; the runtime default is unchanged.
Not-found choices carry plain-language option labels; inside a Try, steps left at a non-failing value offer Fail so Catch can handle it.
Option labels from schema metadata render in all choice selects.
Fixed pickers resolve dependencies by value, so parent re-renders no longer reload options and swallow selections.
Ticket assignment has a flat editor (Assign to user or team, team mode, also assign) with a fallback to individual fields when parts are references or expressions.
In-app notification recipients use Notify users / Notify everyone with these roles pickers; email to/cc/bcc use an address chip editor accepting Name <address>.
Array inputs of any supported entity kind get a multi-picker; multi-user pickers show a focused search box on long lists.
Generic pickers (priority, status, role…) use the real SearchableSelect; popovers are wider than their trigger and stay in the viewport.
Trigger timezone is a searchable select with the tenant default first.
CustomSelect drops Radix scroll buttons so the first click on a long list commits the option under the pointer.
Designer and runtime read one expression function catalog; contains, startsWith, endsWith, lower, upper, truncate and substring are available and bounded.
The loop index is offered as index (bound by the runtime), not $index.
Caught-error fields come from one definition (category, message, nodePath, at, code, details); vars.<captureErrorAs> is offered first inside Catch and not after the Try/Catch.
Wait for Time defaults to Duration with empty units, shows only the selected mode's fields, and summarizes the wait in words.
Save status shows Saved · time / Unsaved changes / Not saved yet next to Save Draft.
Publish shows a toast and a Published vN / Not published chip; the version field reads Next version to publish with an explanation.
First publish asks for confirmation describing what will start the workflow (event, date, or manual).
Header Active/Paused switch applies immediately, rolls back on failure, uses trigger-aware wording, and is read-only without edit rights.
Workflow settings accept an empty concurrency limit as unlimited, roll toggles back on failure, and phrase validation errors in plain language.
Browser tab title follows the workflow name; saving keeps the selected step; the config panel scrolls to top on step change and shows step config before workflow settings.
Workflow loading is keyed on the route id (mount, popstate, bfcache) so Back after the first save never shows an empty New Workflow.
Session expiry opens a Your session ended dialog that keeps the in-memory draft; a per-workflow local backup is offered on reload when newer than the last save.
The config panel resize handle is visible, double-click toggles wide, and the width is remembered per browser.
Run dialog defaults to Form Builder with blank payloads, readable field labels, a picker for every entity id kind, and date / date-time pickers.
Picking a real record fills related payload fields the author has not edited (replacing sample values), including ticket reply fields and contract client and end date.
Date-trigger test payloads derive offsetDays, occursOn and fireDate from the trigger and the picked record via the shared occurrence rule used by the scheduler.
Contract and asset pickers show end and warranty dates, a visible client filter, and say which promised fields a picked record lacks.
Payload validation issues come back structured and render inline under each field in plain language; errors show after interaction or a start attempt.
UUID id fields without a picker offer Generate test id.
The Run dialog keeps a draft payload per workflow across close and reopen, with Start over.
Run start feedback: success toast with View run; engine-unreachable failures explained in plain language with View failed run and technical details; 3 s connect deadline with progress text.
Run is disabled while paused with a tooltip explaining why.
Run Studio shows step names, non-crossing then/else edges, Run source: Manual test, a breadcrumb and Back to workflow, and explains runs that never reached the engine.
Workflow list has a row menu (Open, Run…, Pause/Resume, View Runs, Delete) and an Unpublished changes badge computed from the real draft/published difference.
Designer audit shows user names in a stacked list without horizontal scroll.
Re-registering nodes and actions during dev hot reload replaces them instead of throwing.
